commit_message: Fix IBL light bind group layout
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds a generic runtime EnvironmentMap source, renderer-owned diffuse irradiance/GGX specular preprocessing, a split-sum BRDF LUT, and shared StandardLit IBL while preserving the legacy ambient fallback and keeping the visible sky independent. Fixes the light bind-group layout so the IBL resources are declared by Light BGL rather than Tonemap BGL.
